onboarding/screens/setup-page: Keep content width, scroll area and footer arrangement. Button margin is layout, not a new BackButton visual system.
screens/empty-project-screen: Keep route/application composition. Delegate empty appearance to EmptyProjectWindow.

composer/editing/composer-editing-contex: Keep editing state provider. This file needs no text role or visual wrapper.
composer/editor/composer-editor-adapter: Keep Lexical value/selection bridge. Share the editor presentation contract, without styling state plugins.
composer/editor/composer-story-samples: Treat as a story helper, despite the non-story suffix. Move reusable story scaffolding outside production source when implementation begins.

composer/identity/development-identity-b: Keep development identity separate from status tone. Use paired foreground/background and a named compact mono text recipe.
composer/layout/composer-attachments: Keep attachment-row placement and action layout. Delegate chip slot geometry to ComposerAttachmentChip.

composer/layout/composer-editor-area: Keep editor-area placement and local measurement. Delegate text appearance to the editor adapter.
composer/layout/composer-form: Keep submission/state logic and responsive form placement. Delegate visuals to ComposerCard and toolbar patterns.
composer/layout/session-plan-popover: Keep plan state/content. Share composer trigger/popup-shell recipe. Keep task markers and motion in the plan owner, not Badge internals.
composer/references/composer-reference-m: Keep reference navigation/selection logic. The ReferenceMenu pattern owns its popup appearance.
Keep editor list interaction. Use popover ground and a scoped reference-option recipe. Share supported/unsupported tone with inline references.
composer/references/composer-reference-p: Keep text-entity synchronization. Use the editor node adapter for styling, not global text-role overrides.
composer/references/composer-ticket-refe: Keep ticket parsing and deletion behavior. Share the editor reference presentation contract.
composer/references/context-picker/conte: Own context-option selected/disabled/focus recipes. Share icon and reference tone, not a menu-item wrapper for unrelated menus.

composer/toolbar/turn-configuration-menu: Keep model choices and selected-state content. Share composer popup/trigger recipe. Use a named ChoiceRow treatment rather than a separate manual radio appearance.

composer/tray/attachment-tray: Keep tray measurement/placement and attachment lifecycle. Delegate the shared permission/attachment patterns to their owners.
feed/content/code-language-icon: Keep language identity as an approved asset treatment. Separate brand type/weight from general text roles. Use local icon geometry instead of important overrides.
feed/content/feed-code: Reuse app CodeBlock and shared Feed card treatment. Copy-button size belongs in CodeBlockCopyButton, not this caller.
feed/content/feed-images: Keep gallery/image frame geometry and failure placeholders local. Use opaque Feed media surfaces and the same gallery recipe for Markdown images.

feed/delegation/delegation-event: Keep delegation content and navigation. Share work-state tone mapping and inline icon recipe without changing registry defaults.

screens/session-screen-details: Keep state/query orchestration and localized handoff facts. Delegate repeated presentation to SessionShell/composer/inspector patterns.

connection/source-field: Keep Combobox/Field interaction and error descriptions. Use public labeling APIs. Do not add a generic wrapper just for w-full.

status/status-menu: Keep status mapping and radio selection. Reuse TicketMenuTrigger and registry menu defaults.
status/ticket-label: Keep provider-colored Badge adaptation. Boundary validates six hex digits. Use an approved contrast-safe tint recipe and fallback for unreadable labels in both appearances.

shell/inspector-split/inspector-toggles: Keep show/hide/reset actions and direct Button sizes. Layout-motion belongs to the split owner.
